chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about a man who performs hajj on behalf of another: does he receive any reward and recompense from that? He said:

The one who performs hajj on behalf of another shall have a reward and the recompense of ten hajj, and forgiveness is granted to him, his father, his mother, his son, his daughter, his brother, his sister, his paternal uncle, his paternal aunt, his maternal uncle, and his maternal aunt. Indeed, Allah is All-Encompassing, Generous.

key_terms.الْأَجْرِ: the divine reward granted for the act
key_terms.عَشْرِ حِجَجٍ: the reward equivalent of ten pilgrimages
key_terms.يَحُجُّ: performs hajj on behalf of another person

ai.seo_question: What reward does a person receive for performing hajj on behalf of someone else?
ai.summary: This hadith states that one who performs hajj on behalf of another receives immense reward, equal to the recompense of ten hajj. It also highlights expansive divine forgiveness that extends to the performer and a wide circle of close relatives, showing the greatness of this act of worship and Allah’s generosity.
